description: Implementation of a pseudo-random number generator based on timing and system events, with functions for obtaining raw true random numbers.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Sets a timer interval for generating timing-based randomness.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Handles timer signal to update state for randomness collection.

methods.name: roulette
methods.description: Collects timing data and generates a pseudo-random buffer.

methods.name: raw_truerand
methods.description: Returns a 32-bit pseudo-random number based on timing measurements.
